violations.text: Raw animal foods (shelled eggs and beef) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

(Cooked rice), which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
Inspector observed dead mouse on bait device. PIC removed from premises. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
Tomatoes was observed being being stored on egg carton. PIC informed and removed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (prep table shelves and blender base ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (throughout establishment ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 11/11/2026

The floors in kitchen and back storage area have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/21/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine and g=vegetable slicers) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the restroom. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener and ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the grill tables and prep tables shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. Sink has an airbreak. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The ceiling in the (kitchen above 3 bay sink) area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue , food debris, and/or rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The walls in the kitchen is in poor repair. Observed holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back storage and dumpster) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
